description: Big risk, big tech upside: about 40% chance of a huge win (tech, money, fame), otherwise a painful money loss.

effects.text: It works. Against every odd, it works.
It doesn't work. It costs you, in every sense.

description: Small, safe gain in money or skills that costs energy.

effects.text: A small win, paid for in sleep.

description: Mostly flavour: tiny effects either way. Use for the 'do nothing' or 'shrug' option.

effects.text: Life goes on, mostly unchanged.

description: Money now at an ethical cost: money up, ethics and impact down.

effects.text: The money arrives quickly. The feeling stays longer.

description: The lower-carbon option that costs some comfort or money: impact up, footprint down for a decade.

footprint.label: A lower-carbon habit you picked up

effects.text: Slightly less comfortable, noticeably lighter.

description: Time with people: social and happiness up, a little energy down.

effects.text: You come home late, tired and full.

description: A public bet: 50% fame up, 50% public embarrassment.

effects.text: It lands. People are talking about you, nicely.
It flops, publicly. Screenshots exist.

description: Push hard: usually money up and energy down, with a 30% chance of a real crash in energy and happiness.

effects.text: You deliver. Your body sends a polite complaint.
You deliver, and then you collapse on the sofa for a week.

description: Give time or money to others: impact and ethics up, money down.

effects.text: It costs you something. It's worth more than that to someone else.

description: Learn something hard: AI and soft skills up, energy down.

effects.text: Your brain hurts in the good way.

description: A trip far away: happiness and social up, money down, one long-haul return flight.

effects.text: Jet lag, sunsets, a story you'll tell for years.

description: Surprise job offer from a moonshot employer: 50% rocket ride (money, fame, tech), 50% crash landing.

effects.text: The rocket actually flies. You're on it.
The rocket wobbles. You learn a lot, fast, mostly about chaos.

description: Surprise job offer from a mission-driven employer: low pay, high meaning.

effects.text: The salary is small. The reason to get up is not.

description: Surprise job offer with very high pay in an ethically grey business.

effects.text: The pay is unreal. So are some of the clients.

description: Surprise job offer from an odd, creative employer: fame and fun, unstable money.

effects.text: Weird job, great stories, decent pay. Your parents still don't get it.
Fun, chaotic, and paid mostly in exposure.
